title: DIY Striped Bag 👜 Pinterest Style Made Easy ✨ #diybag #sewingproject  #bagmaking #totebag
description:
Can you believe I made this at home? 🏠💖 From a piece of cotton to this high-end striped tote! 🤐 I’ll show you how to draft your own pattern and install zippers like a pro. ✂️ Full masterclass is linked below! Don't miss out on this easy DIY! 🧶✨
🎥Here is the full tutorial with step-by-step FREE PATTERN making 👉 https://youtu.be/pfYDrQGPkdo
-----------------------------------
🧡Get the PDF patterns, exclusive behind-the-scenes, and personal stories on my Boosty: https://boosty.to/diycraftstv
❤️ My Instagram https://instagram.com/tatiana_diy
•♥•♥•♥•♥•♥•♥•
✂️ Materials ✂️
🔹 Main fabric of your choice (I used heavy-weight striped cotton)
🔹 Spunbond non-woven interfacing
🔹 Heavyweight fusible fleece (for that perfect structured look)
🔹 Lining fabric (any matching fabric works great!)
🔹 12" Nylon coil zipper (approx. 30 cm) for the main closure
🔹 9.5" Nylon coil zipper (approx. 24 cm) for the pocket
🔹 Webbing strap — approx. 51" (130 cm)
